MB-ACT-0.1 candidate for Member B (Chengsi Li, @ChengsiLi).
Traceability: AH-01 -> UC-01 / UC-01E -> Activity Diagram (Criterion C8).
1. Original customer statements and evidence are strictly append-only and immutable.
2. The UI never creates business state; Domain Service authoritatively governs case lifecycle.
3. UC-01E handles targeted clarification without silent discarding or automated rejection.
4. Clarification loop properly feeds back into evaluation until complete, timed out, cancelled, or escalated.
